toolSpec.name: extract_case_info
toolSpec.description: Extract case information from pharmaceutical complaint documents

case_id.description: Unique case identifier from the complaint report

receipt_date.description: Date the complaint report was received

criticality.description: Potential risk to patient from product defect; values: Critical (life threatening), Major (serious risk), Minor (minimal impact). Extract explicitly from fields or narrative where clearly indicated; do not infer if ambiguous.

category.description: Product classification or high-level complaint category (e.g., Medical Device, Pharmaceutical Drug, Initial, Follow-up). Extract from dedicated fields or narrative context; may be multiple values.

case_type.description: Classification of case type: Adverse Event, Product Complaint, Both (AE and PC), or Neither; multiple values possible based on case. Derived from explicit fields or narrative analysis.

report_type.description: Type or source of report, e.g., Spontaneous, Clinical Trial, Literature for AE; Spontaneous, Internal, Field/Service, etc. for Product Complaints. Extract from fields, narrative, or document metadata; may be null or NA if unavailable.

narrative.description: Full detailed narrative describing the complaint, including patient or product issues

narrative_summary.description: Concise (100-150 words) AI-generated summary of the narrative covering key points such as patient condition, product information, adverse event or complaint nature, and outcome

primary_reporter.description: Name and address of the primary reporter as found in the report; use NA if not available

patient_name.description: Name of the patient mentioned in the report; NA if unavailable

physician_name.description: Name of the physician mentioned in the report; NA if unavailable

product_details.description: Structured product information including drug name, dosage, lot number, and expiration date; NA if unavailable
